_note: Example MCP config used while building Ghost Pomodoro. It grants the filesystem server access to the project directory ('.') only. No credentials, no network tools, and no other servers are configured here. If you run this in Kiro, confirm the working directory is the ghost-pomodoro project root before starting the server.

filesystem.description: Filesystem MCP server used during development: lets Kiro inspect, read and list project files (specs, steering, source) with scoped access to the project directory only.
